duplicateOwnerId: Two owners have the same ID. Remove and add one of them again.
duplicateRecoveryContactId: Two recovery contacts have the same ID. Remove and add one of them again.
duplicateRecoverySigner: Recovery contact {number} lists the same signer key more than once.
duplicateScheduledPaymentId: Two scheduled payments have the same ID. Remove and add one of them again.
invalidStakeCredential: Choose a valid Cardano stake credential.
invalidWalletSettings: The wallet settings could not be read. Refresh the wallet and try again.
newScheduledPaymentDateOrder: Scheduled payment {number} must start before it ends.
newScheduledPaymentPaidAmount: Scheduled payment {number} must start with 0 already paid.
newWalletPayoutHistory: A new wallet cannot contain a previous spending-limit payout date.
ownerLimit: Up to {limit} owners are supported. Remove an owner to continue.
reachableAccessRequired: Add at least one owner or one recovery contact who can withdraw funds.
recoveryContactLimit: Up to {limit} recovery contacts are supported. Remove one to continue.
recoveryContactCanWithdrawNow: A recovery contact can withdraw from this wallet now because the wake-up timer has expired. If this is not intended, refresh the timer or set a future recovery date before continuing.
recoveryTimerFieldsMustMatch: Set both the recovery start date and owner check-in interval, or turn both off.
recoveryTimerRequired: Set a recovery start date before adding recovery contacts.
scheduledPaymentLimit: Up to {limit} scheduled payments are supported. Remove one to continue.
sharedRecoverySigner: Recovery contacts {first} and {second} cannot use the same signer key.
signerKeyLinkedToMultipleOwners: Signer key {wallet} belongs to owners {records}. One signature adds their combined approval weight of {power}. Required approvals treat them as one signer.
walletNameTooLong: Wallet name must fit within {limit} bytes.
walletFundsUnavailableUntilRecoveryDate: This wallet has no owner or required-approval path, and its only recovery contact cannot withdraw until far in the future. Funds will remain unavailable until then. Set an earlier recovery date or add another recovery contact.
